notes: DEPRECATED skill, retained only for backward compatibility. Its frontmatter sets disable-model-invocation: true AND user-invocable: false, so it is unreachable by both the model and a direct slash command — nothing should invoke it. It is auto-replaced by the SubagentStart hook at plugins/cbr/hooks/subagent-context-inject.js (matcher .*-agent), which fires on every role-agent spawn with the same domain_match*0.4 + recency*0.3 + importance*0.3 scoring and <=1500 token budget. (The SKILL.md's replaced_by still points at the stale .claude/hooks/... path — a known path-reconciliation gap; the live file is under plugins/cbr/hooks/.) Evals document non-invocation, not behavior.
